agent_deployment_artifacts_platform_chec.name: agent_deployment_artifacts_platform_check
agent_deployment_artifacts_platform_chec.value: ("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."operating_system" IS NULL AND "radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."architecture" IS NULL AND "radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."variant" IS NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."operating_system" IS NOT NULL AND "radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."architecture" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."operating_system") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND char_length("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."architecture") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND ("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."variant" IS NULL OR char_length("radius_platform"."agent_deployment_artifacts"."variant") BETWEEN 1 AND 64))

agent_deployments_verification_time_chec.name: agent_deployments_verification_time_check
agent_deployments_verification_time_chec.value: ("radius_platform"."agent_deployments"."verification_state" = 'pending' AND "radius_platform"."agent_deployments"."verification_completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."agent_deployments"."verification_state" IN ('verified', 'quarantined', 'revoked') AND "radius_platform"."agent_deployments"."verification_completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

agent_environment_revisions_deployment_a.name: agent_environment_revisions_deployment_action_check
agent_environment_revisions_deployment_a.value: ("radius_platform"."agent_environment_revisions"."action_code" = 'revoke' AND "radius_platform"."agent_environment_revisions"."agent_deployment_id" IS NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."agent_environment_revisions"."action_code" <> 'revoke' AND "radius_platform"."agent_environment_revisions"."agent_deployment_id" IS NOT NULL)

account_identities_email_check.name: account_identities_email_check
account_identities_email_check.value: "radius_platform"."account_identities"."email_normalized" IS NULL OR (char_length("radius_platform"."account_identities"."email_normalized") BETWEEN 3 AND 320 AND "radius_platform"."account_identities"."email_normalized" = lower("radius_platform"."account_identities"."email_normalized"))

agent_installation_observations_error_ch.name: agent_installation_observations_error_check
agent_installation_observations_error_ch.value: ("radius_platform"."agent_installation_observations"."observation_state" IN ('failed', 'blocked_incompatible') AND "radius_platform"."agent_installation_observations"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,127}$') OR ("radius_platform"."agent_installation_observations"."observation_state" NOT IN ('failed', 'blocked_incompatible') AND "radius_platform"."agent_installation_observations"."error_code" IS NULL)

idempotency_records_response_check.name: idempotency_records_response_check
idempotency_records_response_check.value: ("radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."record_state" = 'pending' AND "radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."response_status" IS NULL AND "radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."response_body" IS NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."record_state" = 'completed' AND "radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND "radius_platform"."idempotency_records"."response_body" IS NOT NULL)

job_outbox_published_check.name: job_outbox_published_check
job_outbox_published_check.value: ("radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."message_state" = 'published' AND "radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."published_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."message_state" <> 'published' AND "radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."published_at" IS NULL)

job_outbox_terminal_error_check.name: job_outbox_terminal_error_check
job_outbox_terminal_error_check.value: ("radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."message_state" = 'failed' AND "radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."terminal_error_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."message_state" <> 'failed' AND "radius_platform"."job_outbox_messages"."terminal_error_code" IS NULL)
